data.one_liner: A lightweight, customizable logger for Dio HTTP client built on Talker.
data.what_it_does: It intercepts Dio requests and responses, printing formatted logs with optional colors, filters, and custom settings. Logs can be routed to a Talker instance for unified tracking.
use_when: You need detailed, customizable logging for Dio network calls
You already use Talker for logging and want integration
You want easy toggling of request/response data and headers
avoid_when: You are not using Dio (e.g., using http package)
You need a logger that works without Talker
Performance-critical apps where logging overhead must be zero
weaknesses: Works only with Dio, not other HTTP clients
Adds dependency on Talker for full features
Logging overhead may affect very high‑frequency requests

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides built‑in logging via interceptors without extra packages

data.minimal_example:
final dio = Dio();
 dio.interceptors.add(TalkerDioLogger(settings: const TalkerDioLoggerSettings(printRequestHeaders:true, printResponseHeaders:true, printResponseMessage:true)));
